description: Record progress on one Must or habit from the user's plan for today or yesterday, then return the updated score. Check-off habits are marked done. Count and duration habits have the amount added to the day's total; two logs at the same time both count. It never lowers or undoes a value. Do not repeat a call after a timeout; check get_power_day first.

amount.description: Whole amount to add for count or duration habits (minutes for duration). Ignored for check-off habits.
